name: nGZSceneGraph::cCompositionTreeNodeImpl::MakeEmptyAttributeEntryRange
notes: Lane OM. The iterator's own bodies: Clone 0xa37630, Get 0xa37720 and the deleting destructor 0xa37080 are in effect through this hook (their entries); its other slots are folded across classes (shared_vf_178b20 QI, 148fb0 AddRef, 1aafb0 Release, 148260 IsEqual, 140fe0 Next / Previous, 300a0 Advance, 1aac30 At): ours implement them for our objects, the game's stay unclaimed. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, 16 on src/sg/cNullArrayAttributeEntryIterator.cpp: QueryInterface's iid test, AddRef and out, AddRef's and Release's results, Release's delete, Clone's count and identity, IsEqual, Get, At, the builder's cursor, counts, ends and result): 16 killed.
